<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="queen-black-dragon" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Queen Black Dragon</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/LRKGH3H3yP.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Queen_Black_Dragon <nowiki>Queen Black Dragon</nowiki>]<nowiki> resides in the lowest level of the Grotworm Lair which can be found just west of Port Sarim. 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="Summoning" title="Summoning" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required to be able to enter the arena via the Summoning portal. Before attempting the fight it is </nowiki><em><nowiki>highly</nowiki></em><nowiki> recommended to have at least level 80 in your preferred combat style (generally </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) and access to super antifire potions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Completion of the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Song_from_the_Depths <nowiki>Song from the Depths</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest is recommended as well to reduce the amount of damage received.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=5qeONiK3mTiH18UBWxrL <nowiki>Ranged | Basic</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=8905598c-eb45-4bcd-b9e8-7c733d1a5453 <nowiki>Ranged | Advanced</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F8905598c-eb45-4bcd-b9e8-7c733d1a5453.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Slayer Helmet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> bonus for being on a Dragon/Black Dragon task </nowiki><strong><nowiki>does</nowiki></strong><nowiki> work on the Queen Black Dragon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ QBD uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks
⬥ QBD send a fire wall.
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attacks only occur if the player is standing 2 tiles north from the platform artefact.
⬥ Phase ends when her HP is depleted and the middle artefact is activated.
    • QBD will spit out grotworms until you activate the artefact.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Fire Wall</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The chatbox will say </nowiki><code><nowiki>The Queen Black Dragon takes a huge breath.</nowiki></code><nowiki>
⬥ Fire wall deals 750 typeless damage for each tick it hits you.
    • You can walk through it to only take 1 tick of damage.
⬥ Each firewall has a gap where you can stand to avoid damage.
    • This gap will either be the 5th, 9th (one left of the center artefact) or the 15th square.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ All mechanics persist however with each Phase her fire wall gets stronger.
    • In Phase 1, the firewall will have 1 wall you have to pass through.
    • In Phase 2, it will have 2 walls.
    • In Phase 3, there will be 3 walls, and so on.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Tortured Souls</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ There will be an onscreen message saying </nowiki><code><nowiki>The Queen Black Dragon summons one of her Captured Souls.</nowiki></code><nowiki>
⬥ A Tortured Soul appears and releases a cloud that deals 900 damage.
    • The cloud can be made to hit a Tortured Soul or grotworm first.
    • This can be done by walking through the soul at the right time.
⬥ She summons 2 and 4 should in phase 3 and 4 respectively.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Any Souls in the arena can now be used to heal QBD.
    • The chatbox will say </nowiki><code><nowiki>The Queen Black Dragon starts to siphon the energy of her mages.</nowiki></code><nowiki> and will heal her 200 each tick from each Tortured Soul.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Crystal Form/Hardened Carapace</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ P3 onwards QBD can change her form.
⬥ If QBD takes on the consistency of crystal.
    • Takes 25% less </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage and 25% more </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage.
⬥ If QBD hardens her carapace.
    • Takes 25% less </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage but 25% more </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Time Stop</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ P4 onwards a Soul can appear in one of the corners of the arena saying 3 of the following:
    • </nowiki><code><nowiki>Time is short!</nowiki></code><nowiki>
    • </nowiki><code><nowiki>She is pouring her energy into me...hurry!</nowiki></code><nowiki>
    • </nowiki><code><nowiki>The spell is nearly complete!</nowiki></code><nowiki>.
⬥ Kill the Tortured Soul or QBD before the Tortured Soul says all three.
⬥ If all dialogues are said, you screen will freeze for a few seconds, unable to move, eat, or do anything until the special is over.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Extreme Dragon Breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ A high hitting attack prompted by the chat box saying, </nowiki><code><nowiki>The Queen Black Dragon gathers her strength to breathe extremely hot flames.</nowiki></code><nowiki>
    • Can be mitigated by moving to the sides of the arena.
    • Standing in the middle will cause high damage.
    • This also is the special attack needed to brand the Royal Crossbow.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="rotation"><ins><nowiki>Rotation</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This rotation achieves alternating 24s and 25.8s kills.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Rotation assumes camping </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1" alt="jasdragonbanearrow" title="jasdragonbanearrow" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Make sure to pre </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the QBD.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ May use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayer" title="dragonslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the start of every 2nd kill, just before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1"><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>At 1.2s </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → tag pillar</nowiki></p>
